Wow, I’m really disappointed in @Apple’s Siri in iOS 27. It reminds me of 2012, when we would talk about how Apple is just years behind everyone else. They wait 5 years after everyone else already has something and then present it as new.

Same thing here. After I highlight something and click the Siri button, it invites me to ask a question about the thing. Then it has no idea what I’m talking about. But that’s not the biggest issue. There’s no prompt engineering at all. I think it’s running GPT-3.5 Turbo. These are the kind of crappy answers that could be generated on-device,

with maybe a quick google search to improve answer relevance, so I can understand the server-side processing due to the larger prefill due to the search.

items.title: 🤖 GPT-2’den GPT-6’ya Yapay Zekanın Evrimi: Cümle Tamamlamadan "Otonom İş Ortaklığına" Büyük Dönüşüm! 👇
items.summary:
🤖 GPT-2’den GPT-6’ya Yapay Zekanın Evrimi: Cümle Tamamlamadan "Otonom İş Ortaklığına" Büyük Dönüşüm! 👇
Birçoğumuz ChatGPT’yi günlük işler için kullanıyoruz ama arka planda dönen milyarlarca dolarlık teknolojik savaştan ve mimari değişimden haberdar değiliz. Paylaştığım infografik, yapay zekanın sadece 7 yılda nasıl "insan beyni" hızına ulaştığını net bir şekilde özetliyor.
İşte teknoloji tarihine yön veren o büyük kırılma noktaları:
🧠 2019 - GPT-2 (Sıfır Örnekli / Zero-Shot)
Her şey 1.5 Milyar parametreyle başladı. GPT-2’ye bir metin veriyordunuz ve o sadece istatistiksel olarak bir sonraki kelimeyi tahmin ediyordu. Henüz ortada bir "asistan" yoktu, sadece gelişmiş bir metin tamamlayıcı vardı.
🚀 2020 - GPT-3 (Az Örnekli / Few-Shot)
Parametre sayısı tam 175 Milyar'a fırladı! "Bağlam içi öğrenme" (In-context learning) hayatımıza girdi. Sisteme birkaç örnek verdiğinizde ne yapmak istediğinizi anlayıp harika çıktılar vermeye başladı. Yapay zekanın asıl miladı buydu.
👁️ 2023 - GPT-4 (Çok Modlu / Multimodal)
Sadece metin değil; fotoğrafları, grafikleri ve dökümanları da anlamaya başladı. RLHF (İnsan Geri Bildirimli İnce Ayar) ile sisteme "insani mantık" aşılandı. 8K-32K bağlam penceresiyle devasa dosyaları tek seferde okuyabilir hale geldi.
🧬 2025 - GPT-5 (Akıl Yürütme / Reasoning)
OpenAI’ın o meşhur "Düşünen Yapay Zeka" (o1/o3) devrimi. Sistem artık soruyu görür görmez refleks olarak cevap vermiyor; "Akıl Yürütme Jetonları" (Reasoning Tokens) harcayarak arka planda derinlemesine düşünüyor, strateji kuruyor ve hata payını sıfıra indiriyor. ChatGPT içerisindeki akıllı yönlendiriciler (router) sistemin beyni oldu.
🌐 2026 - GPT-6 (Asenkron ve Otonom Araçlar)
Ve bugün ulaştığımız son nokta... GPT-6 artık sadece bir sohbet botu değil; sizin yerinize arka planda saatlerce çalışan, kod yazan, analiz yapan "Asenkron Araçlar" kullanıyor. 1.05 Milyon bağlam penceresiyle koca bir kütüphaneyi hafızasında tutuyor, "tur ortası yönlendirme" ile konuşma esnasında kendi hatalarını anlık düzeltiyor ve tamamen aranabilir kişisel notlar tutuyor.
💡 ÖZETLE: Yapay zeka artık "cümle kuran bir çocuk" aşamasından, "sizin yerinize şirket yönetebilecek otonom bir iş ortağı" seviyesine ulaştı.
Sizce bu hızla gidersek önümüzdeki birkaç yıl içinde yapay zeka iş dünyasını nasıl şekillendirecek? Bilgileri kaybetmemek için yer işaretlerine eklemeyi unutmayın, yorumlarda tartışalım! 👇

items.title: Agentic AI Raises New Questions for Financial Institutions
items.summary:
DownloadDownload

Artificial intelligence (AI) has moved beyond answering questions and generating content. Increasingly, AI systems are being designed to act. Agentic AI can pursue objectives, make decisions and take actions on a user’s behalf, potentially with limited human involvement in individual decisions. [...] Consider a customer who gives an AI agent access to a bank account with an instruction to manage the customer’s cash efficiently. The agent decides to transfer funds, convert currencies or purchase an investment.

At first sight, these may appear to be ordinary customer transactions. Agentic AI, however, exposes important distinctions between identity, authentication, authority and attribution. [...] As agentic AI becomes more capable, firms may increasingly encounter interactions in which an AI agent collects information, compares products and initiates transactions for a customer. That creates a new layer between the institution and the person or entity with whom it has established a customer relationship.

items.title: He’s using AI to screen existing compounds for therapeutic potential | University of Pittsburgh
items.summary: Developing pharmaceuticals using AI isn’t new, but it is laborious and often leads to a dead end. “If you generate a brand-new molecule, that’s actually a limitation,” Wang said. “A lot of compounds can’t be synthesized, and that is a big issue.” [...] This back and forth is the GAN’s training. Over time, the generator learns to generate fingerprints that more closely resemble those of real molecules. Researchers then search chemical databases for existing compounds with similar footprints; the AI-generated pattern leads to the discovery of real molecules that researchers can test — no need to synthesize a new molecule. [...] In a paper published Oct. 28 in the journal Science Advances, Wang outlined Full-Spectrum Generative Lead Discovery (FSGLD), a novel, practical and reusable framework that takes advantage of generative AI to screen for existing compounds with potential for therapeutic development.

items.title: Sở Khoa học và Công nghệ Hà Tĩnh hướng dẫn xét công nhận sáng kiến và đánh giá hiệu quả đề tài khoa học
items.summary: Theo hướng dẫn, các giải pháp được xem xét công nhận là sáng kiến bao gồm: giải pháp kỹ thuật, giải pháp quản lý, giải pháp tác nghiệp và giải pháp ứng dụng tiến bộ kỹ thuật. Trong đó, giải pháp kỹ thuật có thể là sản phẩm, vật liệu, giống cy trồng, vật nuôi hoặc quy trình công nghệ; giải pháp quản lý là phương pháp tổ chức, điều hành công việc; giải pháp tác nghiệp là các phương pháp thực hiện nghiệp vụ chuyên môn; còn giải pháp ứng dụng tiến bộ kỹ thuật là việc áp dụng các giải pháp kỹ thuật [...] Đối với các đề tài khoa học, đề án khoa học và công trình khoa học – công nghệ, việc xét nghiệm thu thực hiện theo quy định của pháp luật về khoa học và công nghệ. Các đề tài chỉ được xem xét công nhận hiệu quả áp dụng và phạm vi ảnh hưởng khi đã được nghiệm thu đạt yêu cầu trở lên.

items.title: Tháo gỡ rào cản để đưa công nghệ sinh học vào lĩnh vực nông nghiệp
items.summary: Thông qua hội nghị này, các đại biểu, chuyên gia và tổ chức quốc tế sẽ cùng chia sẻ những kết quả nghiên cứu, xu hướng mới nhất về công nghệ sinh học, biến đổi gen và chỉnh sửa gen trên thế giới. items.title: Andrej Karpathy:
items.summary:
Andrej Karpathy:

“A 1B model can be much more effective than most current LLMs.

90% of current models waste a ton of capacity and money on remembering stuff that doesn’t matter.”

here is his 5 core thesis about Small LLM’s:

1. the intelligence was never the knowledge. Strip the memorized internet, keep the reasoning. What’s left is the cognitive core, and it’s small.

2. the core might fit in ~1B params. Maybe less. “Plenty of room at the bottom.” We’ve been paying for a library when we needed a brain.

3. size stopped being the bottleneck. What makes an agent work is the tools it can call and how tight the feedback loop is, not parameter count.

4. intelligence lives in the system, not the weights. A raw LLM is a CPU with no OS. Small core + good harness > giant model alone.

5. you can own it. A model on your hardware is one no one can rate-limit, price-hike, or deprecate on you.

in 12 months the gap between teams shipping on-device and teams paying per-token frontier bills won’t be capability.

TwIL an 8.8B model at 90%+ of frontier isn’t a benchmark flex.

It’s the thesis Karpathy’s been repeating all year, made real.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Bài toán này không cần sử dụng công cụ, tôi có thể giải thích cho bạn.

Nguyên hàm của \( x^2 \) là một hàm \( F(x) \) sao cho \( F'(x) = x^2 \). Theo quy tắc tích phân, nguyên hàm của \( x^2 \) là \( \frac{x^3}{3} + C \), trong đó \( C \) là hằng số tích phân.

Vậy, nguyên hàm của \( x^2 \) là \( \frac{x^3}{3} + C \).

https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: OpenAI to pay for data center power after election shows AI concern
items.summary: AI companies like OpenAI depend on AI data centers to serve customers and develop new models, and they're seeking to build out as rapidly as possible to meet demand. In February, OpenAI told investors that it's targeting $600 billion in total compute spend by 2030, and the company has since announced massive data center projects in Georgia and Ohio. [...] The artificial intelligence company said in its commitments that for data centers it owns and operates, it will solicit community input, publish construction plans and stay away from use of non-disclosure agreements with public officials. Additionally, in a policy blueprint, OpenAI encouraged policymakers to enact similar commitments as laws. [...] OpenAI has repeatedly pledged to protect ratepayers and invest in local communities this year, and Lehane said the company's latest commitments build on many of its previous initiatives. He said the policy blueprint has been in the works since August, and that he met with dozens of lawmakers and candidates since then.

items.title: OpenAI gets $11 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation, source says | Reuters
items.summary:
Nov 6 (Reuters) - OpenAI has closed ‌on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round ​that values the company ​at $1.25 trillion, a source familiar with ⁠the matter said on Friday.

The $11 ​billion raised so far represents ​only a portion of OpenAI's original target of up to $30 billion, while ​the company's valuation has ​come down from the $1.5 trillion level it ‌had ⁠initially sought, two investors said. items.title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say | Reuters
items.summary:
Even before OpenAI launched ChatGPT in late 2022, some company staffers raised concerns internally about its security practices, according to five people familiar with the matter. Employees shared their concerns with top OpenAI leaders ​and the board of directors, the people said, adding that some staffers came away from those interactions concluding that management was more focused on keeping pace with competitors like Google and Anthropic than on security. [...] Another issue is that OpenAI had not done regular security reviews of its internal tools, such as the so-called sandboxes where researchers stress-test new models, three people familiar with the company’s practices said. Employees often modified those tools for their work, but those changes were not always tested for security problems, leaving them potentially vulnerable to attacks from outsiders, the three people said. [...] OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

Some OpenAI employees are increasingly worried about this approach as AI grows more capable, according to the five people.
